name: Smoked Cashew Salsa
desc: Cashews smoked over applewood then blended with chipotle in adobo

ingredients.raw: 4 Tbsp small wood chips (preferably applewood), soaked 30 min, drained
ingredients.item: small wood chips (preferably applewood), soaked 30 min, drained

ingredients.raw: 4 canned chipotle chiles in adobo, drained, seeded

steps: Line a stock pot with foil and add soaked wood chips. Heat on high until smoking.
Place a steamer basket in the pot and spread cashews evenly. Cover and smoke 10-15 minutes, until golden brown and aromatic.
Transfer cashews to a blender with 3 chipotles, 1 Tbsp sugar, a pinch of salt, and ¾ cup water.
Blend until very smooth. Adjust to taste with more chiles, sugar, salt, or water for consistency.
